invariants.rationale: Since method returns null if divisor b is zero, method exit means b is non-null and not zero.
Method returns null only if division by zero, but at exit, result is assigned and method did not return early with null.
Result is computed as division of a by b, in appropriate numeric form.
Method requires a non-null parameter for division to occur.

invariants.expression: (a instanceof Integer && result instanceof Integer) || (a instanceof Double && result instanceof Double)
invariants.rationale: Result type matches the input numeric type.
